title: RTPS: Add SM2/SM3/SM4 algorithm recognition in security attributes
description:
Add recognition of SM2/SM3/SM4 (ShangMi) algorithms in the crypto
algorithm requirement masks propagated during RTPS discovery. Three
RTI vendor-specific algorithm bits replace generic "Vendor Specific
Algorithm" placeholders in the RTI bitmask arrays:

  Symmetric cipher:    SM4_GCM at bit 16 (0x00010000)
  Digital signature:   SM2_SM2P256_SM3 at bit 18 (0x00040000)
  Key establishment:   SM2_KXEPH_SM2P256 at bit 18 (0x00040000)

AI-Assisted: yes (Copilot)
